parameters.name: instanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the nodes that you want to query. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
The node state that you want to use to filter nodes. Valid values:

*   `all`: query nodes in the following four states.
*   `running`: query nodes in the running state.
*   `removing`: query nodes that are being removed.
*   `initial`: query nodes that are being initialized.
*   `failed`: query nodes that fail to be created.

Default value: `all`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs describe-cluster-nodes --cluster-id c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000 --instance-ids i-bp11xjhwkj8k966u0000,i-bp1dmhc2bu5igkyq0000 --nodepool-id npe25633140a7d4fbea56cd0479c000000 --state running --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --node-names cn-hangzhou.192.168.0.1 --node-ips 192.168.0.1 --node-labels nodeLabels=app=nginx,env=prod --region cn-hangzhou
